status: FROZEN on the day E and F started training, before any of D, E or F had produced a checkpoint or a forecast. The SHA-256 of this file is recorded in the commit that froze it and in every screening report.
title: Screening round 3: a soft threshold, a smaller dose without one, and what chance alone does
note: Follows round 2 (screening_round2_plan.json), whose threshold series at fixed dose found the spread collapse grows with how hard the threshold clips. Selection on the validation period only; a candidate that passes needs a full-length run and a separate frozen test on data no choice here has seen, the winter 2026-27 data.

candidates.tailD2000: finetune_tail_d at step 2000: variant B's threshold of 5 mm per 6 h with a softplus instead of a hard clip, softness 2 mm per 6 h, weight a tenth of its measured equal-on-extremes weight (measured before it trains), the dose of A to C
candidates.tailE2000: finetune_tail_e at step 2000: variant C, the term with no threshold, at a third of C's weight, 13.03. Chosen after seeing C's round-2 result, which is why it is screened here and not there

reference.tailC2000: variant C from round 2, scored alongside so E's change from it can be read

noise_reference.control2000s2: finetune_seed2 at step 2000: the control arm again with base seed 20261003 instead of 20260909. Never ranked. Its difference from control2000 on every measure is the size of a difference between two identical recipes

training_matched: Every model at step 2000 of the same 3 000-step learning-rate schedule, same data and ensemble size; same seed except the noise reference.

gate_spread.measure: spread-skill ratio difference, candidate minus control2000, lead 30 h
gate_spread.fails_if: the point estimate is below -0.05 or the upper 95% bound is below -0.025
gate_spread.why: Unchanged from round 2, so the rounds compare.

ranking_metric.measure: fair twCRPS at 20 mm per day, candidate minus control2000, lead 30 h
ranking_metric.passes_if: the point estimate is at or below 0

guard_ordinary_weather.measure: fair CRPS over all cases, candidate minus control2000, lead 30 h
guard_ordinary_weather.fails_if: the candidate is more than 1 percent worse

decision.pass: passes the spread gate, the ranking metric and the guard
decision.winner: the passing candidate with the lowest twCRPS at 20 mm; ties within 0.002 go to the lower weight (E, then D)
decision.if_none_pass: No full-length run of a loss variant. Report rounds 2 and 3 together, with the noise reference as the yardstick, and move the effort to post-processing.
decision.reading_with_noise: A winner whose twCRPS advantage is smaller than the noise reference's own distance from control2000 is reported as indistinguishable from chance, though the rules above still name it.

reported_not_decisive: fair twCRPS at 50 mm per day
occurrence ratio O_t and share of exceedances no member reached, at 10, 20 and 50 mm
the noise reference's differences from control2000 on every measure above
